## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+; $1K paper ~= 14% headline (as per playbook)
2. **Sample bias:** We have only run a Stage-1 BS-synthetic test (n=1 combo). Overfit risk is high without OOS and real-fills.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (walk-forward test not yet run)
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (validation on top 3 J days not yet run)
5. **Failure modes:** Worst day in BS-synthetic was 2025-Q1 (-$1300.5) but this may change with OOS/real-fills. Max drawdown in BS-synthetic was $4701.52. Blow-up scenario: consecutive losing days in adverse regime.
6. **Concentration:** In BS-synthetic, top5_pct is 999.0 (indicating negative total P&L and concentration calculation issue). We need OOS/real-fills to compute a meaningful concentration metric.
